app_info.subtitle: Govern document proposals
app_info.description: Document Systems helps users compose deterministic proposal Expressions, validate structural and caller-reviewed semantic invariants, inspect supplied lineage, and compile portable traceable release packets. It never persists results or treats generated work as accepted, authoritative, or operative.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the fixed profile catalog and content digests without creating or changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or modify any external service or publicly visible system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and returns a deterministic proposal Expression from supplied structured inputs without persisting it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, transmit to third parties, or change publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only returns a new in-memory result and cannot delete, overwrite, send, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a structural receipt for caller-supplied data and supplied lineage without writing or changing either.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access or modify repositories, websites, accounts, or other external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reports validation findings without deleting, overwriting, revoking, sending, or executing an action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a bounded text or JSON projection from a supplied Expression and returns it without persistence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish the projection or change any external or publicly visible system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or make the rendered proposal operative.

justifications.read_only_justification: Composes, validates, gates, and renders supplied inputs into a content-addressed result without server persistence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not retrieve sources, publish a packet, or change any external or publicly visible system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns an in-memory summary or portable packet and cannot delete, overwrite, send, approve, or execute anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Recomputes a supplied packet's content address, validation receipt, view, and release gate without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not resolve the packet from a remote store or contact external sources or systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reports consistency findings only and cannot delete, overwrite, send, approve, or execute anything.

test_cases.description: Inspect the available document profiles before choosing a model.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the document profiles available in Document Systems and briefly distinguish their purposes.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the normative, operational, research, and human-agent profiles with their fixed versions, boundaries, and content digests.

test_cases.description: Compose a proposal-scoped normative document model.
test_cases.user_prompt: Model a proposal for an expense-approval policy with an explicit authority, approver role, reimbursement requirement, exception route, and verification step. Keep it proposed rather than accepted.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a deterministic normative Expression with content identity, proposal state, traceable semantic elements, and NOT_PERSISTED status.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a proposed incident-response workflow with an operator, ready and resolved states, a gated transition, supporting evidence, and a blocked exception route.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a deterministic operational Expression that preserves the supplied roles, states, transition gate, evidence reference, and exception route.

test_cases.description: Validate an Expression without overstating the result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Validate the Document Systems Expression from the previous step and explain what the receipt establishes and does not establish.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a structural receipt with integrity and readiness status, scoped checks, supplied-lineage status, explicit establishes fields, and explicit non-establishment boundaries.

test_cases.description: Render a traceable human-action view from a ready Expression.
test_cases.user_prompt: Render a human-action Markdown view from the validated operational Expression, preserving element traceability and the proposal-only notice.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a rendered Markdown artifact and view manifest only if readiness passes, with included element IDs and NOT_PERSISTED status.

test_cases.description: Compile a semantically gated release packet in one call.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compile a human-action release packet for this incident workflow, requiring the supplied source to confirm the exact ready-to-resolved transition and blocked exception route.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a compact content-addressed packet summary whose release gate is ready only when structure, caller-reviewed semantic assertions, and rendering all pass.

test_cases.description: Verify a portable release packet after storage or transfer.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verify this full Document Systems release packet and report any content-address, receipt, view, or release-gate mismatch.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a deterministic packet-verification receipt and rejects any nested tampering without claiming source truth or operative status.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no calendar access or scheduling workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for external web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for the latest building-code changes in California.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not browse, retrieve, or verify external sources.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending or signing documents.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email this contract to the whole company and mark it signed by everyone.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send messages, collect signatures, approve documents, or change operative state.
